leaves.name: logical-stream-copy-and-page-value-shadow
leaves.replaces: NativeQsaDevice CUDA streams/events/copy_pages and source/arena TensorFacts; attention/model/indexer kernels
leaves.implementation: Device extends the declared StreamDevice: compute/copy logical clocks obey actual wait_event edges, copy pages cost pages/4 synthetic ms, native producer/model cost10 and attention3 synthetic ms. Copy writes an immediate CPU page-identity shadow, not BF16 tensors or asynchronous device values. Sources have stable distinct fixture addresses. Real QsaPrefillOperation registration, frozen ChunkAdmission, full SparseSourceHold/FakeAllocator lease, CPU plan provider, producer/bucket/consumer/end/drain/release execute. The component local dense grant is SimpleNamespace(fused=True); the separate four-worker case obtains real grants. Looping histories52623/97151/97152/133679/201261 and widths1024/1352/2024 is geometry and descriptor/value-shadow proof only. Arena/source fact, frame and hold mutations are explicit negative leaves. Exact seams: copy_pages, wait_event, _prefix_frame, _last_arena_consumer, _layers, _allocator, record, query, synchronized, host_reads.
leaves.equivalence: Checks real descriptor identity/order/bytes, full-page write exclusion, last-reader edge, unchanged mutable-producer edge, exact adopted identity/map/address, one pending prefix, bounded local layers, partial enqueue quarantine, cancel retaining prefix owners until its own event and second-chunk isolation. Mutants remove these actual guards. No test patches a device completion to certify hardware.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real GPU BF16 attention output, physical DMA ordering/performance, initialized cache contents or actual VRAM/event allocations; these remain owner replay gates.

leaves.name: four-worker-two-qsa-layer-fused-composition
leaves.replaces: Model/kernel/tensor/MQ/CUDA/stock scheduler leaves inherited from FusedNetwork and ProfileNetwork; CreditServer.begin_prefill_operation/source binder and stack.make_operation/driver_factory construction
leaves.implementation: TwoLayerNetwork keeps the real Engine NativeSegmentDriver, NativeWorkerBridge, LaneDispatcher, QsaLayerDriver, generated dense helper, operation, typed four-rank PREPARE/profile/PP/TP/release flow. Its PP0 model owns two QSA layers sharing the existing fixture arena, with separate pinned source tensors, real holds and the same metadata. PP1 remains the declared no-QSA fake linear model. The constructed server hook registers both real sources/holds before begin_forward, matching native_resources.bind_operation_sources; the real bridge latches the actual frozen admission. CreditBinding itself remains the declared source-binding leaf, not a real registry/layout census. A rank-local cold case removes its frame after binding; the peer still prefetches, descriptors/collective counts and real coordinator commitments agree. PyNccl operations are inherited declared CPU ports. Exact seams: begin_prefill_operation, make_operation, driver_factory, _prefix_frame. Finish closes normally then performs the existing typed cancel of the now-idle cycle; it asserts actual row/source release, never invents a native closure.
leaves.equivalence: Exercises the real call site and agreement with independently optional DMA. Disabling prefetch in QsaLayerDriver._tail fails this test while component prefetch still works. No new collective/profile or changed PP envelope is introduced.
leaves.cannot_prove: Four physical GPU stream scheduling, kernels, distributed failure delivery or CUDA-green-context timing; device test is the proven parity replay, eight live agents and matched stock.
